facts.fact: Rohan carries the queen's wax as a wafer in a flat tin, with a single line in her hand folded under it: 'Pritam holds Neshar for us and not for himself. We so say.' Signed Sarala. The seal impression shows a thumb-shaped thread of red.
facts.why: needed because the beat requires the pressing of the blood-mixed seal and the revoking of Pritam's claim on the page (C19).

facts.fact: Meera's count records her crew by marks, not names; she enters it under her own name only, keeping the crew out of the record.
facts.why: needed because her public confession must not give up crew names (bible: she will not give up her crew).

facts.fact: The matching brass buttons share a nick filed in the rim; a clerk holds them together to confirm they are twins.
facts.why: needed to make the 'button matches' beat checkable on the page.

facts.fact: A grey-bearded officer in a plain slate cloak lays his sword belt on the grass at the Fair and stands unarmed; no one names him.
facts.why: sets up Tej's exile (S6) without naming him; Meera does not know his name.

facts.fact: Prince Kunal tells Meera her count is 'entered' and cannot be unsaid; he does not reveal himself as the masked buyer.
facts.why: needed to show the record holds her confession (S5 stays hidden).

facts.fact: Rohan says in his speech that he hanged two men under the Closing Law and one was a seventeen-year-old carrying salt to his mother.
facts.why: pays off F126 in the public admission; no new plot fact.
